# Arena v1 fixtures

This directory holds client and server transcripts, lobby acceptance and refusal cases, a deterministic trace and the suite manifest for fixture suite `arena-v1-hosted-contract`.

The Arena v1 hosted-contract test depends on these records as frozen evidence; never edit them by hand, and cut a new version slot under the [hosted-version rules](../../../../../../docs/one-server-evergreen.md) when behavior changes.
